notes.content: Added confirm button hint to controller select intro, fixed team attack issue, added Steam Deck controller option, chapter 3 progress, fixed NPC quest glitch when using controllers (used to auto-accept quest before displaying the final chat message)

notes.title: 0.01.04 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The cutscene sequence at game startup has been re-added after reprogramming to auto-adjust based on screen size. Also added a fade-in/fade-out effect between slides and added repurposed game artwork to the story panels.

Some NPCs have been re-named and some slight dialogue changes have been made.

The portal inside the doghouse now leads to the outside of the doghouse as it should.

notes.title: 0.01.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have officially released PowerBots Retro! I want to thank you all for all your support and patience as I work to take the game from Early Acces to buttery smooth. This first week has already seen a few major gameplay updates, and I plan to keep looking for ways to improve this game. Bug fixes and additional features are on the way!

Three updates were pushed this week, see details below.

v0.01.01: A quick fix has been uploaded and quests are now up and running again. At launch, completing quests prompted the server to kick the player and it showed as glitchy rooms with no enemies. 

v0.01.02: Temporarily removing the intro story as it was not formatted for all screen resolutions. Working on re-formatting and re-uploading ASAP. (50% complete)

v0.01.03: Fixed a glitch in multiplayer network movement. You shouldn't see players bouncing in random places as much anymore when you leave and re-enter a player-filled room.
